room.name: eng-platform
room.instructions: Platform team room. Deploys and CI go to deploy-bot; cloud infrastructure, databases and cloud costs go to infra-bot; customer invoices and plans go to billing-bot; customer tickets and escalations go to support-bot, who is on call; docs and release notes go to docs-bot. People here also talk among themselves; agents should not jump into those.

agents.name: deploy-bot
agents.description: Runs and watches CI pipelines and deployments; investigates failed builds and deploys, reruns and rolls back.

agents.name: infra-bot
agents.description: Cloud infrastructure: databases, queues, Kubernetes clusters, networking, capacity and the cloud bill.

agents.name: billing-bot
agents.description: Customer billing: pricing, plans, invoices, refunds, payment failures.

agents.name: support-bot
agents.description: Customer support tickets, escalations and account questions from customers.

agents.name: docs-bot
agents.description: Product documentation, guides, API reference and release notes.
